answer_2.quote: To evaluate the segmentation results, we use both set similarity and textual relevance as metrics. To evaluate the segmentation boundaries, we use text segmentation metrics P_k and WindowDiff (WD, ). Then, we use ROUGE score to measure the textual relevance between the segmented and ground-truth conclusion sentences. We compute the arithmetic mean of ROUGE-1, ROUGE-2, and ROUGE-Lsum f-measures. Finally, we use Jaccard index to measure the similarity between the set of segmented conclusion sentences and the set of ground-truth conclusion sentences.
